title: In-place hot-water boiler performance and nominal capacity

on_cycle_parasitic_electric_load_w.description: Rated parasitic electric watts; EnergyPlus scales by operating part-load ratio and resets it to zero when idle.

off_cycle_parasitic_fuel_load_w.description: Nonnegative configured watts. Electric boilers require zero. EnergyPlus 25.2 updates this times (1 - PLR) in active calculation and carries the last rate while idle; this is not a constant idle standby load.

nominal_capacity_w.description: Positive useful thermal output watts or explicit Autosize; retained PLRs affect dispatch/output limits. Flow and sizing factor are preserved.

minimum_part_load_ratio.description: Explicit ratio; combined effective settings must satisfy minimum <= optimum <= maximum. Values above 1 are not clipped; maximum above 1 requires equipment/curve review.

maximum_part_load_ratio.description: Explicit ratio; combined effective settings must satisfy minimum <= optimum <= maximum. Values above 1 are not clipped; maximum above 1 requires equipment/curve review.

optimum_part_load_ratio.description: Explicit ratio; combined effective settings must satisfy minimum <= optimum <= maximum. Values above 1 are not clipped; maximum above 1 requires equipment/curve review.
